rows.label: Anthony Bourdain
rows.hook: traveled the globe eating with locals on TV and wrote a bestselling tell-all about restaurant life

rows.label: Nigella Lawson
rows.description: English food writer and television cook (born 1960)
rows.hook: is known for lavish, comforting home cooking and a glamorous, playful television persona

rows.label: Giada De Laurentiis
rows.description: Italian-American chef, writer, and television personality
rows.hook: is a TV cook known for easy pasta dishes, a bright smile and a famous film-producer grandfather

rows.label: Gordon Ramsay
rows.famous: Hell's Kitchen and fiery kitchen TV
rows.description: British chef, restaurateur, and television personality (born 1966)
rows.hook: is a hot-tempered TV chef famed for swearing at contestants and collecting many Michelin stars

rows.label: Bobby Flay
rows.famous: Iron Chef America and Southwestern grilling
rows.description: American celebrity chef, restaurateur and reality television personality
rows.hook: is a grill master who challenges rivals on cook-off shows and loves cooking with chilies

rows.label: Marco Pierre White
rows.famous: Youngest British chef with three Michelin stars
rows.hook: is a rebellious, long-haired London restaurateur who once trained Gordon Ramsay

rows.label: Julia Child
rows.famous: French cooking brought to American TV
rows.hook: taught home cooks a famed European cuisine in a warbling voice on TV and in a landmark cookbook

rows.label: Guy Fieri
rows.hook: is a spiky bleached-hair host who tours roadside eateries in a red convertible

rows.label: Ina Garten
rows.hook: is a Hamptons-based host famed for easy, elegant entertaining and the catchphrase "how easy is that?"

rows.label: Mary Berry
rows.description: British food writer and television presenter
rows.hook: is a veteran cake expert who judged amateur cooks in a tent on a hit TV contest

rows.label: Delia Smith
rows.hook: is a bestselling cookbook author whose recommendations make shops sell out of ingredients

rows.label: Jamie Oliver
rows.hook: is a casual, cheerful TV cook who campaigned for healthier school lunches

rows.label: Yotam Ottolenghi
rows.description: Israeli-born chef, cookery writer and restaurant owner
rows.hook: is a London restaurateur famed for colorful, veggie-forward dishes and cookbooks like Jerusalem and Plenty

rows.label: David Chang
rows.hook: began with a ramen restaurant in New York's East Village and grew it into a restaurant empire

rows.label: Emeril Lagasse
rows.famous: New Orleans Creole cooking and a shout of Bam
rows.hook: is famed for the catchphrase "kick it up a notch" and spicy Louisiana flavors

rows.label: Anne Burrell
rows.hook: was a spiky-haired TV chef known for coaching hopeless kitchen newbies in a boot camp

rows.label: Ree Drummond
rows.hook: is a blogger turned TV host who cooks hearty meals on a working cattle ranch in Oklahoma

rows.label: Rachael Ray
rows.description: American television host, businesswoman, celebrity cook, and author
rows.hook: is a perky TV host famed for quick weeknight dinners and the acronym EVOO

rows.label: Alton Brown
rows.hook: is a quirky TV host who explains the science behind cooking and commentated on Iron Chef America

rows.label: Heston Blumenthal
rows.famous: The Fat Duck and molecular gastronomy
rows.hook: is famed for experimental dishes like snail porridge and bacon-and-egg ice cream

rows.label: Rick Stein
rows.description: English chef, writer and television presenter
rows.hook: is a TV travel-cook who built a restaurant empire in a Cornish harbour town and loves fish

rows.label: Thomas Keller
rows.description: American chef, restaurateur, and cookbook writer
rows.hook: runs a legendary Napa Valley restaurant and a New York sibling, both with three Michelin stars

rows.label: Auguste Escoffier
rows.hook: organized restaurant kitchens into a ranked brigade system and worked alongside Ritz at luxury hotels

rows.label: Wolfgang Puck
rows.hook: opened a trendy Los Angeles restaurant and is known for gourmet pizza and catering Oscar parties

rows.label: Paul Bocuse
rows.hook: was a Lyon chef honored with a world cooking contest named for him and a long-held top Michelin rating
